_comment: Hand-authored, baked-audio lines for the fixed cast's undercurrent.
Director-only: never sent to a language model, never logged, never shown in a codex or recap.
Every line needs approved_by_abe: true before tools/bake_undercurrent_audio.py will render it.
A line with parts is an exchange: the bake tool renders each part in its own voice and joins them into one clip, with a short gap between.

lines.speaker: nova
lines.text: Damn it, Kaelen! I told you this could happen!

lines.speaker: nova
lines.text: Kaelen! That is exactly what I warned you about!
lines.approval_note: DRAFT by Claude (2026-09-24), awaiting Abe. Closest to your line. Same beat, different words, for a player who has already heard yours.

lines.speaker: nova
lines.text: I told you it was too soon, Kaelen. I told you!
lines.approval_note: DRAFT by Claude (2026-09-24), awaiting Abe. Adds 'too soon': hints they are in the middle of something, without saying what.

lines.speaker: nova
lines.text: No, no, no. Kaelen, pull it back. Pull it back now!
lines.approval_note: DRAFT by Claude (2026-09-24), awaiting Abe. Hints the death might be undone. Slightly bolder.

lines.speaker: nova
lines.text: Kaelen, we are not doing this again. Do you hear me? Not again.
lines.approval_note: DRAFT by Claude (2026-09-24), awaiting Abe. Boldest: 'again' suggests they have lost the Captain before. Save for a player's third or later sighting, or drop it.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Nova! You could have pulled Shiny out of that. You just watched!
lines.approval_note: DRAFT (2026-09-24), awaiting Abe. Abe's idea (Kaelen blames Nova), Claude's wording. Uses 'Shiny' instead of a pronoun so it fits every Captain.

lines.speaker: kaelen+nova
lines.text: Don't look at me, Nova. This is not coming out of my cut. / Shut up, Kaelen.
lines.approval_note: DRAFT (2026-09-24), awaiting Abe. Abe's exchange: Kaelen's jab, then Nova's reply, baked into one clip.

parts.speaker: kaelen
parts.text: Don't look at me, Nova. This is not coming out of my cut.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: That was yours to catch, Nova. Yours!
lines.approval_note: DRAFT (2026-09-24), awaiting Abe. Short Kaelen variant of the blame line.
